dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Joining a defecting operation needs to come with a warning label.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: How was I supposed to know that it came with trouble?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: I wanted to lay back, not pushback.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Don't be such a whiner!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: We won, didn't we?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: That egotistical, good for nothing Commandeer...

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: We can't let it get in the way.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I don't know why it's trying to destroy this vinyl

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: But it's the first thing in...

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: ... forever...

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: ...that we've gotten from the humans.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: This has to be important.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Sure, but are we just gonna run around playing music until everybody is dancing around the planet?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: I am NOT built for that kind of persistence.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Before we started, you did nothing but move stuff around.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: That's, like, the most persistent, constant thing I could think of.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Flat does have a point.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: He does?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Yeah, he does?

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: He does! We need to increase our reach.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Commandeer just needs one good strike against us to stop everything.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, we need to consistently be playing our best.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Here's our situation...

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: We, TEMP-OS, are trying to relay music to the colony.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: So far, our budget plan is to travel and play for bots passing by.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: But these means are-

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Exhausting?

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Flat! Shush!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Guys. Let Trill speak.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Well, uh, yes! Exhausting!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: For both us, general resources, and time.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Well, my connection to colony communications was cut shortly after we started all of this.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I could reconnect it if we made it back to my station!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: That's true! But I imagine you've been blacklisted from every location on the planet.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Probably blacklisted off planet too.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: If they can't handle the way I work then they don't deserve me!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: We could get an override, but those are stored in the colony's Information Hub.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Which is gonna have a much bigger “audience”, won't it?

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: ... Yes.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: But! It is guaranteed to have the codes!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: So...

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: We sneak into the Information Hub.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Grab the override code to my station.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Which is now Commandeer's station.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Semantics.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: And once at my station, we reconnect with the colony communications.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Then broadcast the best jam of our construction!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Couldn't have put it better myself, Major!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: No objections from me!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Almost makes me nostalgic for my scouting days!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: And this is better than doing it the slow way?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I thought you were complaining about the slow way?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Okay, but now I know my options are the slow way

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Or the ''confront practically every bot on the colony all at once'' way.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: We won't force you to do something you don't want to do.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Well, I didn't say I didn't want to do it.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Besides, Chromatic would never let me live it down.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Very true.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Don't worry Flat!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: If everything goes to plan, TEMP-OS won't encounter a single opposing bot.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Ah, I love it when a solid plan comes together.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Gather your things, TEMP-OS! We're journeying to the Information Hub!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: We're journeying now?!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Update Project Overture! Let's pick up speed!
